notes.title: 🎮 New Update is Live! 🎮
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players!

We’ve brought a small but impactful update to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new in this patch:

🐞 Bug Fixes:

Rare crash issues in the in-game save/load system have been resolved.

Fixed invisible wall issues in certain areas.

⚡ Performance Improvements:

Reduced FPS fluctuations on low-performance devices.

Memory usage optimizations implemented (for a smoother experience!).

✨ Minor Tweaks:

Some character animations have been refreshed.

Adjusted text sizes in the UI based on player feedback.

🍎🚜 Coming Soon:

Brand-new fruits and vegetables will soon join the game!

New tools are being added to bring a breath of fresh air to gameplay.
(Currently in development—details coming soon!)

📢 Note:
Your feedback helps us strive for excellence! If you try the update and share your thoughts in the comments, we’d be thrilled to hear from you.

Thank you, and happy gaming!

notes.title: 🎉 Big Update is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Dear players,[/b]

We’re excited to say hello to you with a thrilling update to our game! With this update, we’ve added a brand-new truck and a variety of delicious fruits and vegetables to the game world. Now, more diversity and fun await you in the game!

What’s New?

[b]🚚 New Truck:[/b]
We’ve added a brand-new truck to the game! With this truck, you’ll be able to transport your goods faster and more efficiently. With its sleek design and powerful performance, this truck will take your gaming experience to the next level!

[b]🍉 New Fruits and Vegetables:[/b]
We’ve added new fruits and vegetables to the game world. Now, you’ll be able to sell new products to your customers at your stalls. Cauliflower, cabbage, melon, and watermelon have been added! These new products will make your market adventure more colorful and enjoyable.

We always value your feedback. So, don’t forget to share your thoughts about the new update with us!

[b]Happy gaming! 🎮[/b]

notes.title: New Update: Change Calculations, Price Tags, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Dear players,  [/b]
We’ve released a new update to make your gaming experience even better! Here’s what’s included in this update:  

[b]1. **Fixed Typos in Change Calculations!**  [/b]
   - We’ve resolved typos in change calculations. Now, you can give change more accurately and clearly.  

[b]2. **Price Tag System Renewed!**[/b]  
   - Product price tags have been updated to a more modern and user-friendly design. You’ll now find it easier to view and manage prices.  

[b]3. **Add Descriptions to Products!** [/b] 
   - You can now add descriptions to products. This feature will allow you to showcase your products in more detail.  

[b]4. **Various Bugs Fixed!**[/b]  
   - Based on your feedback, we’ve fixed several bugs and made general performance improvements.  

This update is all about making your experience smoother and more enjoyable. We’re constantly improving thanks to your feedback, so please keep sharing your thoughts and reporting any issues you encounter.  

[b]Happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: New Update: Bugs Fixed and Improvements Added!
notes.content:
[u][b]Dear players,  [/b][/u]
We’ve made some important updates to make your gaming experience more enjoyable and seamless. Here’s what’s new in this update:  

[u][b]1. **Visual Overlaps Fixed!**  [/b][/u]
   - We’ve resolved the issue of images overlapping at the stand. You’ll now enjoy a cleaner and more organized interface.  

[u][b]2. **New Warning Texts Added!**  [/b][/u]
   - We’ve added explanatory warning texts to certain points in the game. This will make it easier for you to understand what to do next.  

[u][b]3. **Bag Placement Guide and Exclamation Mark!** [/b][/u] 
   - The placement area for bags is now more clearly indicated. We’ve also added an exclamation mark to the bag placement area, so you’ll know exactly where to place it.  

[b][u]4. **Various Bugs Fixed!**  [/u][/b]
   - Based on your feedback, we’ve fixed several bugs and made general performance improvements.  

This update is all about making your experience better, and we’re constantly improving thanks to your feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts and reporting any issues you encounter.  

[b]Happy gaming![/b]  
[b]
The Sefa Game Studio Team  [/b]
